scripts/review-precision-baseline.ts cannot reach. The extractor reads
`closed by <sha>` markers out of a report; these rows carry dispositions
that live in an owning flow's description or journal, or in a LATER review
record that resolves an earlier finding.
Every row states the file its evidence is in and quotes it, so a reader can
check the claim without trusting this file. A finding with no defensible
evidence gets NO ROW: the script then reports it as `unknown`, which is the
honest answer and the one that keeps the precision figure from being
dismissed-out-of-scope | dismissed-deprioritised. Only the first two enter
